name: HBLateral Instant Donation Checkout
author: hblateral

sections.description:
Most donation plugins force you to create campaigns, build forms, and configure success pages and failure pages separately. By the time you’re ready to accept your first donation, you’ve spent hours navigating settings.

HBLateral Instant Donation Checkout takes a different approach: everything lives on a single page.

Activate the plugin, configure Stripe, and your donation page is live — form, checkout, and confirmation, all in one place. No campaigns to create. No page builder required. No scattered configuration across dozens of screens.

Built on WooCommerce for secure, reliable payment processing, HBLateral Instant Donation Checkout is designed for organizations that need a donation page that just works.

See It in Action

No 20-minute walkthrough. No endless setup steps before you see a donation happen. Watch a real donation from start to finish in under 3 minutes:

One Page. Everything Included.

Other donation plugins require you to set up:

  • A donation form (with its own builder)
  • A separate success page
  • A separate failure page
  • A campaign to link it all together

HBLateral Instant Donation Checkout gives you all of this in a single, self-contained page — automatically created at /donation when you activate the plugin. Your donor selects an amount, pays, and sees the result — without ever leaving the page. A confirmation email with all the details arrives instantly. No accounts to create, no dashboards to navigate, no extra steps.

What You Get (Free)

  • Instant donation page — auto-created on activation, zero setup required
  • Stripe payments — secure credit/debit card processing via WooCommerce Stripe Gateway
  • Bank Transfer (BACS) — accept donations via direct bank transfer. Just enable it in WooCommerce and configure your bank details in plugin settings
  • Built-in checkout — payment happens on the same page, no redirects
  • Success and failure states — donors see the result immediately, no extra pages needed
  • Instant email receipts — donors receive a professional confirmation email with all details right after donating. No account needed, no login, no dashboard — the email is the receipt
  • Admin donation list — manage, filter, and track all donations from WordPress admin
  • Predefined amounts — configurable suggested amounts with custom input option
  • Mobile-friendly — fully responsive, optimized for every device
  • Translation-ready — Spanish (es_ES) included, ready for more languages

Pro Features

Need more payment methods or advanced features? Upgrade to HBLateral Instant Donation Checkout Pro:

  • SEPA Direct Debit — Accept bank debits for European donors
  • Tax deduction certificates — Automatic generation and delivery to donors
  • Custom form styling — Colors, backgrounds, and branding from the admin
  • Advanced email notifications — Payment failed alerts for donors and admins
  • Data export — Export donations for accounting
  • Redsys and Bizum (beta, Spain only) — Spanish payment gateways for local donors

Upgrade to Pro

Who Is This For?

  • Nonprofits and NGOs that need a donation page without the complexity
  • Churches and community organizations collecting contributions
  • Open source projects and creators accepting support from their audience
  • Event organizers raising funds for a cause
  • Anyone who wants to accept donations on WordPress without spending hours on configuration

Requirements

  • WordPress 6.0+
  • WooCommerce 4.0+
  • PHP 7.4+
  • WooCommerce Stripe Gateway plugin (free)

Third-Party Services

This plugin connects to the following external services:

Stripe

This plugin processes donations through Stripe, a third-party payment processing service, via the WooCommerce Stripe Gateway plugin. When a donor makes a payment, their payment card details are sent directly to Stripe’s servers for secure processing. No card data is stored on your site.

Data transmitted to Stripe includes: payment card details, donation amount, donor email, and donor name.

  • Stripe Privacy Policy

sections.installation:
1. Upload the hblateral-instant-donation-checkout folder to /wp-content/plugins/ or install directly from the WordPress plugin directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu
  3. Make sure WooCommerce is installed and active
  4. Install and activate the WooCommerce Stripe Gateway plugin (free)
  5. Configure your Stripe API keys in WooCommerce > Settings > Payments > Stripe
  6. Go to HB Donations > Settings to configure your organization details
  7. Done — your donation page is live at /donation

Quick Setup Checklist

  • [ ] WooCommerce installed and active
  • [ ] WooCommerce Stripe Gateway installed and active
  • [ ] Stripe API keys configured (test or live)
  • [ ] Organization name and contact email set in HB Donations > Settings
  • [ ] Visit /donation to verify the page is working
sections.faq:
Do I need WooCommerce?

Yes. HBLateral Instant Donation Checkout uses WooCommerce as its payment processing layer. WooCommerce is free and provides reliable, well-maintained payment gateway integrations.

Is Stripe the only payment method in the free version?

The free version supports Stripe (credit/debit cards) and Bank Transfer (BACS). The Pro version adds SEPA Direct Debit, Redsys, and Bizum.

How do I enable Bank Transfer?

Enable “Direct bank transfer” in WooCommerce > Settings > Payments. Then configure your bank account details (IBAN, account holder, etc.) in HB Donations > Settings — no need to touch WooCommerce’s BACS settings, everything is managed from the plugin.

Does it work with my existing WooCommerce store?

Yes. The plugin creates a standalone donation page and uses its own donation registry. It does not interfere with your WooCommerce products, cart, or checkout.

Do donors need to create an account?

No. Donors don’t need to register or log in. After each donation, they receive a detailed email receipt with all the information they need. Simple and practical — no unnecessary steps.

How are email receipts sent?

Donation confirmation emails are sent automatically through your WordPress email system. For reliable delivery, we recommend using an SMTP plugin like WP Mail SMTP.

Is my donor data safe?

All donor data is stored in your own WordPress database. Payment processing is handled securely by Stripe through WooCommerce. No donor data is sent to third-party services (except the payment processor).

Can I customize the donation amounts?

Yes. Go to HB Donations > Settings to configure the predefined donation amounts and currency.

Is the plugin GDPR compliant?

The plugin stores donor data in your database and processes payments through Stripe. You are responsible for your own GDPR compliance, including having a privacy policy that discloses donation data collection.

How do I get support?

Free support is available through the WordPress.org support forum. Pro users get priority support.
